Athlete Kit.name: Athlete Kit
Athlete Kit.description:
👟 You carry gear for a body in daily training.

⚖️ All of it is legal to own; the boots are a commercial support item sold to the public.
🏫 School competitions can ban support items for students outside the Support Course, so the boots may stay in a locker on event days.
🔄 Protein bars and ice packs are used up on use.

🎒 Starts with: Fitness tracker, Support boots, Protein bar ×4, Ice pack ×2
Athlete Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: The character owns a wristband that tracks heart rate and training, spring-soled support boots with ankle support and grip, a stash of protein bars and instant cold packs for sprains and bruises. All of it is legal; the boots are a commercial support item sold to the public. School competitions can ban support items for students outside the Support Course, so the boots may stay in a locker on event days. Bars and cold packs are used up on use.
